howto:
How to use
your digital planner, step by step
I
iPad · no extra app
Save the PDF to the Files app and open it. Tap the side tabs and dates to move around. Tap the pen icon (Markup) to write, then Done to use the links again. Apple Books works too.
II
Android · no extra app
Open the PDF in Google Drive and tap the pen icon to write with a stylus or finger. On Samsung tablets you can also import it into Samsung Notes.
III
Pencil writes, finger scrolls
Apple Pencil or a Pencil-compatible stylus (Logitech Crayon and similar): Settings › Apple Pencil › “Only Draw with Apple Pencil”. Then the pen writes and one finger scrolls. Rubber-tip styluses and S Pen-free Android tablets: write with the pen, scroll with two fingers.
IV
A link does not open?
Leave writing mode first (Done, or close the pen), then tap. In note apps, use read-only mode or tap with your finger.
V
Your favourite note app
Also works in GoodNotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Penly, Xodo and any PDF app with links. Free plans of some apps limit file size.

connected:
Connected
your planner talks to your calendar
I
Plan by the hour
On every daily page, write your plans next to the hours, then tap + Google event to add one to Google Calendar.
II
Calendar & reminders
+ Google Calendar, + Apple Calendar and + Reminder buttons on every day. Habit, water, bill, birthday and workout pages set repeating reminders in one tap: + Google repeat for Google Calendar and Android, + Apple repeat for Apple Calendar.
III
Focus & breathe
Focus 25 starts a 25-minute timer; 1-minute breathing opens a calm breathing exercise. Both in your browser.
IV
Set up once
Google: sign in to Google Calendar in your browser. Apple Calendar & Reminders: add the free “Plum Calendar” and “Plum Reminder” shortcuts from your START HERE file (uses the built-in Shortcuts app).
